title: Condition-Contrastive Extrapolation for On-Policy Distillation of Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.21195v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves a student language model by training on its own generated trajectories with supervision from a stronger teacher. However, when conditioned on student-generated prefixes, the teacher can favor invalid continuations that violate the question's premises, causing OPD to encourage erroneous reasoning steps. As a remedy, we introduce Condition-Contrastive Extrapolated On-Policy Distillation (CCE-OPD), which makes teacher supervision sensitive to question conditions. CCE-OPD incorporates (1) a fixed-prefix comparison in which the same frozen teacher evaluates the complete question and a counterpart with a selected condition masked, and (2) a bounded log-probability contrast that reweights the teacher distribution into an auxiliary distillation target. On 200 diagnostic reasoning states, condition contrast reduces the rate of preferring invalid continuations from 27.0% to 16.0%. Extensive experiments across

translated_title: 面向语言模型在线策略蒸馏的条件对比外推方法
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在学生语言模型自身生成的轨迹上进行训练，并借助更强的教师模型提供监督信号，从而改进学生模型。然而，当以学生生成的前缀为条件时，教师模型可能会偏向违反问题前提的无效续写，导致OPD鼓励错误的推理步骤。作为补救措施，我们提出了条件对比外推在线策略蒸馏（CCE-OPD），该方法使教师监督对问题条件保持敏感。CCE-OPD包含两个核心组件：（1）固定前缀比较，即由同一个冻结的教师模型分别评估完整问题以及一个被掩蔽了特定条件的对应问题；（2）有界的对数概率对比，将教师分布重新加权为一个辅助蒸馏目标。在200个诊断性推理状态上，条件对比将偏好无效续写的比率从27.0%降低至16.0%。在多种任务上的大量实验表明（摘要内容截断）……
tldr: 提出CCE-OPD方法，通过固定前缀条件对比与有界对数概率对比，使教师监督对问题前提敏感，从而纠正在线策略蒸馏中教师偏好无效续写的问题，将无效续写偏好率从27.0%降至16.0%。
en_tdlr: CCE-OPD makes teacher supervision in on-policy distillation sensitive to question premises via fixed-prefix condition contrast and bounded log-probability contrast, reducing the rate of preferring invalid continuations from 27.0% to 16.0%.
